stage: Post hoc exploratory diagnosis after the original CPM and recovered-normalization results were observed; not preregistration or confirmation
population: The same 96 baseline donors; no new samples or labels
normalization: Unchanged sf_reference primary input; no new normalization fit or alternative selection
RNA_branch: Frozen compact direct RNA encoder only for new control inference; no retraining, calibration changes or full-portrait rerun

control_families.all_mapped: Permute all 23323 observed mapped log-expression values independently within each sample before projection onto model genes. This exactly repeats the prior primary control recipe. It preserves the full mapped-value multiset but can change the selected-feature marginal distribution.
control_families.selected_measured: Permute only the 3524 observed model-selected log-expression values within each sample. Preserve their multiset and keep all 572 missing-feature positions fixed at the frozen zero-input convention. This is a separately labeled added diagnostic, not a renamed original control.

seed_rule: Consecutive integer seeds 20261013 through 20261043 using NumPy default_rng; each family resets its generator for each seed; iterate samples in the frozen input order. Equal seed numbers do not make different-length gene permutations biologically paired.
inference_label_access: Do not read qrel/flow values before the new control embeddings and scores are saved

platform_parity.rank_changes: Report top-10 differences and metric changes explicitly. Compare new controls with the unmodified Linux direct-RNA baseline, never silently replace Mac rankings.

query_scope: Score all unchanged 30 questions x 3 rewrites; quantitative relevance evaluation remains limited to Q01, Q02, Q19
metrics: Original deterministic nDCG@10 plus exact-tie expectation, Precision@10 and grade-2 discovery; average rewrites within question then average three correlated questions; retain every seed

sample_label_randomization.methods: All 27 unchanged methods/controls in the parent measured-three-query rankings
sample_label_randomization.scheme: One sample-index permutation per draw, shared across all three queries, all rewrites and methods; preserve each donor's joint relevance-grade vector
sample_label_randomization.reference: Compute the exact random-ranking mean analytically and verify Monte Carlo means within six simulation standard errors
sample_label_randomization.interpretation: Conditional descriptive random-assignment reference, not new biological replicates, confirmation, general-superiority P values or confidence intervals for independent cohorts

fixed_additional_checks: Saved-Mac embedding pairwise cosine distribution, centered participation-ratio dimension and top-PC variance share for old/new direct/fused and control vectors
Raw-text versus projected-query paraphrase and question-centroid cosine geometry for all 30 questions; separately show the three judged questions
Per-query score range, score-grade Spearman correlations and T/B/combined-query score correlations for all 27 parent conditions
Unmodified CPM versus sf_reference measured-feature clipping and value shifts; missing-feature count remains fixed
Mapped-count sum, size factor, median/IQR normalized expression and zero fraction as descriptive correlates; no fitted explanatory model or causal claim
reporting_rules: Keep all original outcomes, technical failures, seeds and methods; no best-seed reporting
Mark constant-score correlations unavailable, not zero, and do not drop those methods
The two shuffle definitions answer different diagnostic questions; distribution-preserving does not remove effects of gene-specific standardization
Geometry and correlations alone cannot identify the cause or establish biological correctness
No new phenotype labels, model weights, thresholds, prompts, selected genes or source-label inputs
Do not expand confirmatory/wet-lab work or claim the Cell utility gate is passed from this diagnosis
